help.leave: /colosseum leave - leave the queue or forfeit
help.admin.open: /colosseum admin open - open a queue now
help.admin.cancel: /colosseum admin cancel - cancel the open queue
help.admin.end: /colosseum admin end - end the running tournament
help.admin.setlobby: /colosseum admin setlobby - set the waiting area where you stand
help.admin.arena: /colosseum admin arena <n> pos1|pos2 - set a fighter position of arena n
help.admin.arenas: /colosseum admin arenas - show the arena setup
help.admin.reload: /colosseum admin reload - reload config, loot and language files
help.admin.rewards: /colosseum admin rewards - list rewards and chances
help.admin.reward: /colosseum admin reward <player> [n] - roll (or force reward n) for a player
help.admin.rewardlist: /colosseum admin rewardlist <n> - list items a random-item reward can give
help.admin.itemid: /colosseum admin itemid - show the ID of the item in your hand
